description: Full details of one train by its planning ID (UID, e.g. 'C04207'): every public calling point with booked, expected and actual times, platforms and per-stop cancellations, plus — for today's trains — where it was last reported and how late. A cancellation can apply to only some stops. 'lastReport' is the last place signalling or movement data placed the train, not a GPS position. Reasons are National Rail's own words.

date.description: Date the train runs, yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to today (UK time). Past dates return recorded times where the archive holds them (about 14 days of per-stop detail).

planningId.description: Planning ID / UID, e.g. 'C04207'. Get one from find_train or station_departures.

name: get_train
title: Train details and live running
